required_nodes.rationale: Experimental custody is constrained to the workspace and rejects symlink roots.
Pinned model source, license, size, and bytes are independently checked; tampering is rejected.
The successful path uses the existing governed invoker with fixed CPU limits and produces a verified rootless-only receipt.
Control-plane denial prevents model generation and rootless evidence is absent from canonical commissioning custody.
The rootless model identity cannot match a production authority map.
The governed inference routes governor, federation, and trust-epoch auxiliary state into run-scoped workspace custody and restores prior process state.
